headlines.text: 2020 brought us this moment: gold changed shoulders as the AEW TNT Title found a new champion as Brodie Lee vs. Cody battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.90 ? a match fans still talk about ? ending the champion's reign at 10 defenses. This stood as the 10th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. Cody was chasing gold for the 10th time. A shocking, total squash that stunned fans watching live ? Lee dominated Cody from bell to bell, ending his 91-day title reign in brutal fashion and stretchering him out, in a moment many still remember as one of the most jarring title changes in AEW history.
2026 brought us this moment: Daniel Garcia chalked up their 150th recorded AEW match ? a major milestone, facing Claudio Castagnoli vs. Daniel Garcia on Collision, rated 8.06 ? a fantastic contest.
On this day in 2020, Allie made their long-awaited return to AEW television after just over 13 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2026, when Colten Gunn reached a genuine milestone: their 50th match in AEW, facing Gunns & White vs. Infantry & Taylor on Collision, rated 5.70 in a wild trios sprint.

Back on this day in 2026, Kyle O'Reilly reached proof of just how much mileage they've put in: their 100th match in AEW, facing Kyle O'Reilly vs. Orange Cassidy, setting the tone as the night's opener on Collision, rated 6.16.
Looking back to 2026, when Willow Nightingale vs. Maya World clashed for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.05 ? a well-worked match.
